stations.name: start
stations.text: Start: walk ahead (away from the camera).

stations.name: stairs
stations.text: Stairs: lanes with 10, 17 and 25 cm steps.

stations.name: ramps
stations.text: Ramps: lanes at 10, 20 and 30 degrees, up to a 1 m deck.

stations.name: stones
stations.text: Stepping stones: 35 cm posts with growing gaps.

stations.name: bumps
stations.text: Bumps: uneven ground of half-buried spheres.

stations.name: duck
stations.text: Duck under: a 1.3 m beam to crouch under, then a 0.7 m roof to crawl under.

stations.name: gap
stations.text: Jump: two 40 cm platforms with an 80 cm gap.
